name: railo-security
description: Deterministic AST vulnerability remediation and formal verification for AI coding agents.

RAILO_API_KEY.description: Your Railo MCP API key (free tier available at https://railo.dev/app/api-keys)

tools.name: explain_vulnerability
tools.description: Retrieve the formal First-Order Logic safety invariant and canonical AST remediation blueprint for a CWE.

tools.name: verify_syntax
tools.description: Verify that proposed code is syntactically sound and parses into a valid Abstract Syntax Tree without grammar errors.

tools.name: verify_security_patch
tools.description: Formally verify whether an AI-generated patch eliminates a vulnerability without introducing regressions.
